channel.title: Pier & Point · Mission Bay Commons P12: SFF Soccer and Fitness Court
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Mission Bay Commons P12: SFF Soccer and Fitness Court (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Commons P12: SFF Soccer and Fitness Court: Split out of the single record…
item.description: Split out of the single record for the west Commons strip (now the record for parcel P15). P12 is the westernmost parcel, from the west end of the OpenStreetMap park outline to DataSF's Merrimac St centerline plus 6.8 m, labelled "SFF Soccer + Fitness Court" by OCII. Its shape is approximate: the outer edge is OpenStreetMap's, the cut at Merrimac St is drawn from the street centerline and OCII's drawing. P12 has no Assessor lot of its own. Source: OCII, Mission Bay Future Parks CAC Update, Nov 14, 2024 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2024-11/Item%205%20-%20Remaining%20Mission%20Bay%20Open%20Space%20Parcels%20Update.pdf), PDF p.17 legend: "P12 SFF Soccer + Fitness Court", "P13 Community Garden & SPARK Social SF", "P15 Parklab Gardens & Stagecoach Greens".

item.title: Milestone · Mission Bay Commons P12: SFF Soccer and Fitness Court: Rec and Park reports the… (~Aug 2025)
item.description: Rec and Park reports the Future Parks project moving into design: an RFQ (request for qualifications) 'was released in early August' (reported event) and a design team 'should be selected by mid-October' (an expected date; no source read says whether a team was selected) (~Aug 2025). Source: San Francisco Recreation and Park Department.
item.source: San Francisco Recreation and Park Department

item.title: Milestone · Mission Bay Commons P12: SFF Soccer and Fitness Court: OCII's Mission Bay Future… (Nov 14, 2024)
item.description: OCII's Mission Bay Future Parks update to its Citizens Advisory Committee names the Commons (P11, P12, P13, P15, P16, P17) among the parks being planned and shows a transfer to Rec and Park 'end of 2028, upon completion' (Nov 14, 2024). Source: Office of Community Investment and Infrastructure (OCII), 2024-11-14.
item.source: Office of Community Investment and Infrastructure (OCII), 2024-11-14

item.title: Milestone · Mission Bay Commons P12: SFF Soccer and Fitness Court: Rec and Park assumes… (Jul 1, 2023)
item.description: Rec and Park assumes management and maintenance of Mission Bay's park spaces (Jul 1, 2023). Source: San Francisco Recreation and Park Department.
item.source: San Francisco Recreation and Park Department

item.title: Milestone · Mission Bay Commons P12: SFF Soccer and Fitness Court: Interim-use pilot begins on… (~2018)
item.description: Interim-use pilot begins on parcel P12 (OCII's November 14, 2024 Future Parks update, slide 9 timeline: "MB Commons interim use pilots begin on P13 (2016), P15 (2017), P12 (2018)"); the slide names no uses, and the PDF p.17 legend labels P12 "SFF Soccer + Fitness Court" (~2018). Source: Office of Community Investment and Infrastructure (OCII), 2024-11-14.
item.source: Office of Community Investment and Infrastructure (OCII), 2024-11-14
